About 3DDX

3DDX has been a market leader in digital dentistry and restorative solutions. Our in-house teams of dentists, prosthodontists, and technicians have been committed to high-quality, customer-focused support, helping dental professionals worldwide achieve efficiency, accuracy, and better patient outcomes.

20+Years in digital dentistry
500k+Services fulfilled

We always strive to innovate and adapt to advanced technologies in order to provide our clients with the most accurate and reliable digital dental solutions.

What we do

One workflow. Many
ways forward.

From a single restoration to a full-arch case, select the support your practice needs without losing the continuity of the case.

01 / 06

Restorative Solutions

From Single tooth supported crowns to full arch photogrammetry implant restorative solutions, we craft restorations that look, last and function for optimal clinical results.

Explore Restorations
02 / 06

MagnetiX™

Stackable guides and restorations. Developed and enhanced to streamline complex cases into single surgery solutions from bone reduction to immediate full arch restoration.

Explore MagnetiX
03 / 06

Digital Design Solutions

Need full production control? We're here to support your practice with all digital designs for your in-office 3D printer.

Explore Digital Design Solutions
04 / 06

3DDX AI™

AI-powered integrated treatment planning workflow to check case eligibility, review the plan and have full control in approximately 15 minutes, making it your ultimate patient presentation tool.

Explore 3DDX AI
05 / 06

3DDX All-On-X Kit

Our grammetry kit offers wide compatibility for precise implant data capture using your existing intra-oral scanner. Experience surgical and restorative flexibility all at once.

Explore All-On-X
06 / 06

iSmile Aligners

Clear orthodontic aligners providing expert planning, efficient digital and clinical workflow, and premium esthetics for all eligible cases, from active movement to retainer phases.

Explore iSmile

Ways to work with us

From patient records to a
result you can review

The process keeps the clinician involved where it matters, with a clear delivery choice at the end.

  1. Step 01

    Submit records

    Submit your patient records and create your orders through our HIPAA-compliant 3DDX Connect portal.

  2. Step 02

    Validate & design

    Our team checks the records, then develops the design to your prescription and clinical requirements.

  3. Step 03

    Doctor Review

    Review the proposed design with an in-house doctor and request refinements before fabrication.

  4. Step 04

    Choose delivery

    Take a production-ready Digital Design Solutions, or let 3DDX produce, quality-check and ship the appliance.

Digital Design Solutions

Receive a production-ready STL file and manufacture through your preferred in-office workflow.

Complete production

Let 3DDX manufacture, quality-check and deliver the finished appliance to your practice.

We accept both digital scans (intraoral scans) and traditional stone model/PVS impressions, which will be poured into study models. We recommend capturing all tissue anatomy in edentulous spaces. Impressions or scans should record the entire arch of interest, plus a bite registration and the opposing arch.

Yes, you can rush your cases. Simply check “Yes” next to the “Rush if possible” option when placing your order. An additional fee will apply.

We accept both digital scans (intraoral scans) and traditional stone model/PVS impressions, which will be poured into study models. Capture all tissue anatomy in edentulous spaces and the entire arch of interest. We prefer both a bite registration and an impression or scan of the opposing arch.
